title: Why Woodpeckers Never Get Concussions
hook: A woodpecker does not give itself concussions.
script: A woodpecker does not give itself concussions. It can hammer its head into wood at 20 pecks per second. Every single peck hits with 1,000 times the force of gravity. That is far harder than a hit that would knock a person out. So why is its brain fine? Its brain is tiny and light, too small for that force to cause damage. Does its skull work like a cushion, as people said for years? A 2022 study put that idea to the test. It found the skull acts more like a stiff hammer than a cushion. So does a woodpecker's skull really work as a shock absorber?
